What Is an Online ESA Tutor — And How Does It Work?

If your family has an Education Savings Account or scholarship fund, you can likely use it to pay for virtual, one-on-one tutoring. Here's how that actually works.

No Out-of-Pocket Cost 12 States Covered Fully Virtual
Quick Summary

All Inclusive Tutoring Solutions LLC is a confirmed, approved ESA/scholarship vendor across 12 states, helping families understand how to use Education Savings Account funds for virtual tutoring.

An ESA Tutor Is a Vendor Approved to Accept Your State's Education Funds

Most state Education Savings Account (ESA) and scholarship programs — like Arizona's ESA, Florida's Step Up, or West Virginia's Hope Scholarship — treat tutoring as an approved expense category, just like private school tuition or curriculum. An "ESA tutor" is simply a registered vendor whose services families can pay for directly from their scholarship account, usually through a platform like ClassWallet or Odyssey, with zero out-of-pocket cost.

What to Look for in an ESA Tutor

  • Confirmed vendor status in your specific state's program
  • Experience billing through ClassWallet, Odyssey, or your state's platform
  • Subject-matter and grade-level fit for your student
  • A fully virtual format that works with your schedule
  • Transparent, published pricing and packages

Every State's Program Works a Little Differently

Funding amounts, eligible expenses, and application windows vary significantly by state — what qualifies in Arizona may look different in Iowa or South Carolina. Rather than guessing, check the guide for your specific state to see current funding, deadlines, and how to apply.
